title: Binary Tree Right Side View
description:
Given the root of a binary tree, imagine yourself standing on the right side of it, return the values of the nodes you can see ordered from top to bottom . 

 Example 1: 

 Input: root = [1,2,3,null,5,null,4] 
 
 Output: [1,3,4] 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2024/11/24/tmpd5jn43fs-1.png] 

 Example 2: 

 Input: root = [1,2,3,4,null,null,null,5] 
 
 Output: [1,3,4,5] 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2024/11/24/tmpkpe40xeh-1.png] 

 Example 3: 

 Input: root = [1,null,3] 
 
 Output: [1,3] 

 Example 4: 

 Input: root = [] 
 
 Output: [] 

 Constraints: 

 The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 100] . 
 
 -100 <= Node.val <= 100
